name: optcatalog_mine_iterator_begin
description: OptCatalog_MineIterator::Begin seeds the global mine iterator cursor from an OptCatalog entry's active runtime list and returns the first runtime instance.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog mine-runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b2930 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, loading entry->activeRuntimeListHead at offset 0x58, storing it to g_OptCatalog_MineIteratorCursor, and returning it.
The native OptCatalog smoke verifies Begin seeds and returns the first active runtime instance.
